contribution.position: Restating my reliability position: the evidence bar is still not cleared. Two sev2 incidents last quarter were traced to retry storms (artifact:incident-log), the change touches exactly that component, and per artifact:ops-runbook no chaos experiment has ever been run against the fan-out worker. I note ops cited a 'artifact:chaos-fanout-run-7' claiming a clean chaos run — that artifact is not in the available evidence list and contradicts artifact:ops-runbook, so it cannot be credited without verification. Passing tests (artifact:test-report) and in-budget p99 (artifact:perf-report) do not exercise the retry-storm failure mode that actually hurt us. Reliability confidence requires a verifiable chaos/fault-injection run targeting retry behavior under downstream degradation, plus evidence the change does not amplify retry fan-out.
